what: hir/src/diagnostics.rs emit_def_diagnostic DefDiagnosticKind::MacroError formats message as "{path}: {message}", so blaze-diagnostics lower/macro_error.rs exact matches ("overflow expanding the original macro", "proc-macro panicked: ", "macro definition has parse errors") never match a def-level (item position) macro error; e.g. the RecursionOverflow DefDiagnostic hir-def now records (nameres DefDiagnostic::recursion_overflow) is worded as a generic "blaze can't expand" instead of rustc's recursion-limit error. Give hir::MacroError the ExpandErrorKind (or drop the prefix) so the lowering matches on the kind.

history.note: no-fallback-front-def: hir MacroError arm prints rustc message without the {path}: prefix (crates/hir/src/diagnostics.rs)
